newsitem.title: USA: ThermoQuest to buy 2 Life Sciences units.
newsitem.headline: ThermoQuest to buy 2 Life Sciences units.

text.p: ThermoQuest Corp said Tuesday it agreed to buy the Laboratory Products Group and the Hypersil businesses of Life Sciences International for about $167 million.

Hypersil, and the companies of the Laboratory Products Group, are wholly owned subsidiaries of Life Sciences International, which was acquired in March 1997 by Thermo Instrument Systems Inc, the majority owner of ThermoQuest.
The businesses to be acquired had 1996 revenues of about $118 million, according to a press release announcing the transaction.
The purchase price will be paid in a combination of cash, the assumption of debt, and/or the issuance of ThermoQuest common stock, the company said.
These transactions are subject to several conditions, including completion by ThermoQuest of its due diligence investigations and a definitive agreement.

Due to ThermoQuest's majority ownership by Thermo Instrument Systems, for accounting purposes, after the execution of a definitive agreement, the acquisition will be deemed effective as of March 12, 1997, the date Thermo Instrument Systems purchased Life Sciences International, the company said.
